title: FireEscape plugin index
description: Two documents: the signed envelope that travels over the network, and the payload string it carries. The signature (SHA256withECDSA, P-256) covers the exact UTF-8 bytes of the payload string. The launcher's validator (core-model IndexFormat) implements the payload rules below.

key.description: Base64 X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the P-256 signing key.

payload.description: The index JSON, serialized as a string. Signed byte-for-byte.

sig.description: Base64 raw ECDSA signature over the payload's UTF-8 bytes.

id.description: Plugin package name. Unique within the index.

api.description: Class contract and major version, e.g. spike/1. Must be a class the launcher knows.

licenseId.description: OSI-approved SPDX identifier. The launcher's accepted set is in IndexFormat.osiLicenses.

sourceUrl.description: Source repository. Required for every listed plugin.

apkSha256.description: SHA-256 of the APK bytes, lowercase hex.
